scope: Terminal normal reference recheck must write an actual weak scalar conversion to the captured shared cell. Separate from the ten replay sources.

cases.purpose: After initial exact string acceptance, finally changes the captured shared cell to int; strict string identity observes terminal weak conversion to that same cell. Later returned-alias write stays shared.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v;
    try { return $v; }
    finally { echo 'F|'; $v = 2; }
}
$v = 'old'; $alias =& $v;
$r =& g();
if ($alias === '2') { echo 'string'; } else { echo 'other'; }
echo '|', $r;
$r = 'changed'; echo '|', $v;
